dedupe_keys.name: eclipse volttron open platform for distributed sensing and control

description: Eclipse VOLTTRON is an open-source platform for distributed sensing and control: it provides services for collecting and storing data from buildings and devices and an environment for developing applications that act on that data. The site presents it as a secure, interoperable and scalable way for data and devices to connect and make decisions based on user needs, able to run on inexpensive computing resources and manage anything from a handful of devices to many more. Quoted users include ACE IoT Solutions, which builds a data collection and building operations platform on it, ecoLong for energy management and virtual power plants, and EPRI for energy storage research since 2021. The volttron-core package holds the server and client components and needs the volttron-lib-auth and volttron-lib-zmq packages; it requires Python 3.10 or later and is published on PyPI, with release candidates of version 2.0.0 tagged in the repository. Coverage: generic. Access: free source code and packages. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: it is a framework for building applications, so building analytics and control agents have to be installed or written. Simulation uses: live building data feeds and control loops for building digital twins, demand response and grid-interactive building studies. Related records: Brick Schema, Project Haystack and HELICS.
